optimization.description: The `optimization` object of the topology optimisation drivers.

fd_test_tolerance.description: Read only by the sensitivity test drivers (unit: tests/unit/sensitivity/problem_tester.f90:75, default 1.0e-5; regression: tests/regression/sensitivity/problem_tester.f90:75, default 1.0e-3). Tolerance on the finite-difference error at the smallest perturbation; above 0, because the tester aborts when abs(error) > tolerance (tests/shared/sensitivity.f90:199), which a zero or negative value always does. The sensitivity test drivers accept a single constraint at most (see the rule on `constraints`).

fd_test_continuation_iteration.description: Read only by the sensitivity test driver (tests/unit/sensitivity/problem_tester.f90:79): continuation iteration to test at. Default 0.

time_window_test.description: Read only by the time-window test driver (tests/unit/objectives/time_window_tester.f90:107-147).

tolerance.description: Default 1.0e-12. Not negative: a difference is accepted only if `difference <= tolerance` (time_window_tester.f90:233,260), so a negative value fails every comparison and aborts at :272. 0 asks for a bit-for-bit match.

require_steady_state.description: Default false. Needs `case.fluid.freeze_flow: true`, because nothing else freezes the fluid in an unsteady run.

end_times.description: End times of the unsteady runs the tester compares; each entry overrides case.time.end_time for one run (time_window_tester.f90:146-150,170,185). The objective windows are set by `objectives[].start_time` and `end_time`. Default `[case.time.end_time]`.

zero_fields.description: Read only by the user module of examples/wiggles (examples/wiggles/user.f90:58). Default false.

allOf.$comment: steepest_descent_optimizer.f90:182 aborts when the problem has any constraint.

tests/unit/sensitivity/problem_tester.f90:96-108 and tests/regression/sensitivity/problem_tester.f90:88-100 abort ('Specify a) a single constraint b) multiple objectives') for two or more constraints. Only the cases that carry a key read by these drivers alone are caught; the drivers also run cases without either key.

design_hdf5_io.f90:256,311-313,355-358: the design name is stored in the HDF5 design checkpoint and read back into character(len=64); a longer name does not fit and the resumed run aborts with 'design: mismatch in name during HDF5 read'. An all-blank max_runtime reads as no limit (neko src/common/utils.f90:499), like the empty string, so it does not count as set. Only runs that write or read a design checkpoint are affected: restart_file, a max_runtime, or checkpoint.interval >= 1 (the automatic lookup of earlier checkpoint files also reads one). A blank name is not rejected: design_hdf5_io.f90:160-164 ignores the status of h5tset_size_f, so no abort is proven.
The name is held as bytes (json-fortran returns the UTF-8 bytes; design_hdf5_io.f90:160 sizes the attribute with len_trim), so maxLength, which counts code points, bounds the bytes only for ASCII.
